title: Search suggestions float under the field with tips and a contact preview
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail, press /, and look at the panel before typing
Type fro, then clear the field and type the first letters of a person's name; press Down and Up through the rows
Make the window narrow (about 640 points wide, sidebar hidden) and press / again
In System Settings > Accessibility > Display, turn on Reduce Transparency and press / again
expected: A panel floats under the field without moving the list. Empty, it lists People, Recent searches and operators, with tips on the right. Typing fro shows Ask AI (if set up) and from:; a name shows matching people and, for the highlighted one, their details. The highlighted row uses the accent colour. Narrow, the tips go and the list fits. With Reduce Transparency the panel is opaque.
